name: HRMS ESS Profile Banner

html:
Employee Self Service

Everything you can do for yourself, without going through anyone. Every tile opens its list.

📅
Leave Apply for leave and track what is left.
✅
Attendance Regularise a day, or claim time back.
💰
Expenses Claim what you spent, or ask for funds up front.
🕒
Shifts Request a shift change and check in.
✈
Travel Request travel and file your timesheets.
📊
Payroll Your payslips, benefits and tax declarations.
🎓
Training Programmes you are enrolled on, and feedback.
👤
HR Raise a grievance or refer someone.
My profile Your own record — contact details, bank details and who you report to. Before you plan Check the holiday list and your leave types so you plan around them.
